fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Master switch. When OFF (default) the Tally sync agent is told to do nothing and the manual upload flow is unaffected.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Which company's Tally data this agent syncs. One profile per company; VE only for now.

fields.label: Sync Every (minutes)
fields.description: Admin-chosen frequency. The agent only re-imports when this much time has elapsed since the last sync (or when Sync Now is pressed).

fields.label: Only Sync When Tally Data Changed
fields.description: When ON, the agent first asks Tally (via AlterID) whether anything changed since the last sync and skips the full export/import if nothing did.

fields.label: Sync Now (one-shot)
fields.description: Tick to force the next agent poll to sync immediately regardless of interval. Auto-clears after the agent picks it up.

fields.label: Last Sync Status (read-only, written by the agent)
Last AlterID (high-water mark)
fields.description: The Tally AlterID of the most recent successful sync; the agent compares against this to detect changes.

fields.label: Agent Last Seen
fields.description: Heartbeat — updated every time the agent polls for a command.
